Upper Text: [Hand] [Main] By paying 3 cost and placing this card as 1 of your [Legend-Arms] trait or 1 of your level 6 Digimon's bottom digivolution card, ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ all of your opponent's Digimon with as much or less DP as that Digimon.
